title: Counting the Delay in Billing a ShieldCare Claim Excess
content:
The delay in billing an excess on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is counted to the day the excess
stands billed on the plan. Which day it is counted from turns on whether a payout stands booked on the
claim, and on whether the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue.

| What the records show | The delay is counted from |
| --- | --- |
| a payout stands booked on the claim, and the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | the day the amount settled on the claim was paid out |
| a payout stands booked on the claim, and the plan is not one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | the day the claim was decided |
| every other claim | the day the loss was reported |

### Points of judgement

Where no payout stands booked on the claim, neither of the first two rows is reached and the count opens
on the day the loss was reported, whatever the plan's queue position. Where a payout does stand booked,
the queue position alone decides whether the count opens on the day of the payout or on the day of the
decision.

### A case on hypothetical dates

A loss is reported on the 2nd of a month, the claim is decided on the 10th, the payout is booked on the
14th, and the excess stands billed on the 30th.

| What the records show | Days of delay |
| --- | --- |
| no payout booked | 28, from the 2nd to the 30th |
| payout booked, claims not worked ahead of the queue | 20, from the 10th to the 30th |
| payout booked, claims worked ahead of the queue | 16, from the 14th to the 30th |
